title: One undecodable historical row stalls the causal test completion sweep forever, because its cursor only advances on a fully successful page
outcome: One undecodable historical row stalls the causal test completion sweep forever, because its cursor only advances on a fully successful page
acceptance: A page of mailbox_messages or mailbox_relay_intents rows that contains a row whose test-request custody, scope, receipt, peer or settlement fails to decode or validate does not stop the sweep: the cursor advances past it, later qualifying requests on later pages still settle, and the skipped row's identity and reason are recorded in a readable, bounded diagnostic; shown by a test with such a row ahead of a valid request.
Valid rows on the same page as an undecodable row are still planned, and settled history is unchanged.
